sourceIndex.publisher: Dicastery for the Causes of Saints
sourceIndex.scope: Pontifical canonizations by celebration year, not a general-calendar feast list

countingRule: Individually named saint IDs count once even when in martyr groups. Every cohort with explicit crosswalk uses unexpandedMemberCount=memberCount-named member IDs. Approximate Otranto count is separate. Source-listed ceremonial form may be unresolved; no feast date inferred.
liturgicalRule: No individual record in this batch asserts universal feast date, 1962 optional mass eligibility, mass texts, or a change to the principal observed 1962 mass.

groups.label: Martyrs of Damascus: Manuel Ruiz and seven Franciscan companions, and the three Massabki brothers
groups.note: Names of all eight Franciscans and the distinct brothers require person-level expansion. Group is not one individual saint.

groups.label: Teresa of St Augustine and fifteen Carmelite companions of Compiègne
groups.note: Sixteen persons; do not attach the group's event to one invented individual saint ID.

groups.label: Thirty Martyrs of Brazil (André de Soveral, Ambrósio Francisco Ferro, Mateus Moreira and 27 companions)
groups.note: Thirty individual martyrs, not one saint. Expand named person records before individual map/art publication.

groups.label: Antonio Primaldo and companions, Martyrs of Otranto
groups.note: Dicastery says circa ottocento martyrs. Approximate group size; do not add 800 as certified identified persons.

groups.label: Cirilo Bertrán and eight Lasallian companions, Martyrs of Turón
groups.note: Nine Lasallian martyrs form one cohort, distinct from Passionist Inocencio de la Inmaculada who is individually listed in this ceremony. Expand all nine identities later.

groups.label: Cristóbal Magallanes and 24 Companions, Martyrs of Mexico
groups.note: Full cohort of 25: founder Cristóbal is independently named in master; 24 companions still unexpanded. Do not count 25+Cristóbal as 26.

groups.label: Augustine Zhao Rong and 119 Companions, Martyrs of China
groups.note: Vatican Oct 2000 Mass canonized 123 total: 120 Chinese Martyrs including these two Salesian martyrs, and 3 distinct other saints; 117 cohort identities remain unexpanded.

groups.label: Andrew Dung-Lac and 116 Vietnamese Martyrs
groups.note: 117 canonised people, of whom Andrew Dung-Lac is currently a canonical person row; other named martyrs in source still require reconciliation to avoid duplication.

groups.label: Lorenzo Ruiz and 15 companions, Martyrs of Japan
groups.note: Sixteen saints total; 3 members named individually from official year page, 13 await expansion.

groups.label: Roque González, Alfonso Rodríguez and Juan del Castillo
groups.note: Three companions all individually identified from 1988 index.

groups.label: Andrew Kim Tae-gon, Paul Chong Ha-sang and 101 companions, Korean Martyrs
groups.note: 103 canonical cohort, 2 named individually in index, 101 still unexpanded.
